Class ResourceComponentType<T>

java.lang.Object
fr.robie.machineengine.api.resource.ResourceComponentType<T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed
public final class ResourceComponentType<T> extends Object implements net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed
A typed piece of resource metadata, e.g. mymod:temperature (ARCHITECTURE.md §9.2). Values must be immutable and implement equals/hashCode: they decide whether two stacks are the same variant.
